use: Spherical sky and reflective environment for Wake
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset, an equirectangular 360 degree panoramic sky environment for a premium cinematic hydrofoil racing videogame. Very wide 2:1 composition. Horizon exactly across the vertical center, sea-level camera. Upper half: enormously detailed sculptural cumulonimbus clouds, violet blue storm masses and glowing amber sun piercing cloud breaks, physically coherent atmospheric scattering, painterly cinematic realism like a high-end racing game's skybox, not flat illustration. Lower half: dark teal calm open ocean, no nearby boats, no buildings, no text, no UI. Very distant tropical cliffs silhouetted at horizon only. Dramatic sunset on right of panorama, mostly cool midnight/cobalt left. Seamless wrap from left edge to right edge, poles handled for spherical equirectangular mapping. This is only a sky and distant atmosphere backdrop; playable boats, water and islands are rendered separately in real 3D. Rich natural photographic cloud texture and sophisticated lighting, no cartoon polygons, no graphic gradients.
